data.one_liner: A custom Flutter slider widget that accepts a list of ordered values.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom slider widget capable of handling a list of ordered values instead of just a single value. It supports continuous and discrete modes, custom trace patterns, indicators, and custom thumb and track builders.
use_when: You need a slider that allows selecting multiple ordered values on a single track.
You want a simple slider interface similar to the original Flutter Slider but with multi-value support.
avoid_when: You only need a standard single-value slider.
You need complex non-linear range configurations not supported by standard list-based ordered values.
strengths: Simple API that mirrors the original Flutter Slider.
Supports both continuous and discrete value ranges.
Customizable with indicators, thumb builders, and track builders.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic README examples.
Very niche use case compared to standard single-value sliders.
